title: Declare verb credential requirements; mint lineage-only bindings after claim
summary: A persisted tenant scope without a WorkItem claim dead-ended every non-exempt verb at reasoning bootstrap, because the gate keyed on tenant presence rather than credential need — and fresh tenants had no bindTask resolver, so even dispatch could not mint a binding.
reusable_steps: A persisted tenant scope without a WorkItem claim dead-ended every non-exempt verb at reasoning bootstrap, because the gate keyed on tenant presence rather than credential need — and fresh tenants had no bindTask resolver, so even dispatch could not mint a binding
expected_outcome: Rule: the bootstrap gate must key on declared verb credential requirements (none|degrading|required), not on tenant-scope presence. none verbs skip bootstrap; degrading verbs run on the stub chain unbound; unclassified verbs default required (fail-safe). Inside claimed-WorkItem dispatch, mint a lineage-only binding (empty secrets) when no resolver produces one — it attests task lineage while granting zero credentials; point-of-use checks remain fail-closed. Prefer a declared requirement registry over per-verb exemption lists.
